title: Create Server RWD
description: Modpack for the create mod RWD
body: Just a chill Create-focused modpack made for an SMP. Nothing flashy, nothing overdesigned — it’s mainly about building cool machines, messing around with automation, and letting things slowly get out of hand in a fun way. Performance is kept sensible, mods are picked because they fit, and everything’s there to support long-term survival, factories, and dumb ideas that somehow work. It’s not trying to reinvent Minecraft, just give Create some room to shine with friends.
